en: A colorized postcard view of a European city along a turquoise river, with a bridge crossing the water and rows of historic buildings with red-tiled roofs on both banks. A steep hill rises behind the city, crowned by fortification walls and buildings, and to the right is a prominent clock tower on the hillside. Mountains are faintly visible in the background. The caption at the top is in German and identifies the scene as Graz with the Schlossberg and the Schöckl.
